notes.note: The MTC is referenced through a variable (v_mtc := mtc) because ObjectReference ::= ValueRef | FunctionInstance does not allow 'mtc.alive' directly (Titan also rejects it).

Reading 1 chosen: a stopped alive-type component counts as alive for any from. Only the lowest-to-highest index order of a single-dimensional array is checked; the dimension order is not covered because the phrase 'innermost to outermost dimension' is unclear.
A partially initialized component array cannot be detected statically in general, so the test expects a runtime error (ttcn3verdict:error).
Reading 1 chosen: the lazy variable stores the index. The test changes the component states after the operation; re-invoking alive would give index 2 instead of 1.
The MTC is referenced through a variable (v_mtc := mtc), because the BNF ObjectReference does not allow 'mtc.running'.
The reading consistent with 21.3.6-004 was chosen: true means the component is still executing.
Reading 1 chosen: a PTC stopped explicitly by the MTC is excluded, so all component.running is expected to stay true while the other started PTCs are running.
A partially initialized component array cannot be detected statically in general, so the test expects a runtime error (ttcn3verdict:error).
Reading 1 chosen: the size of the index array must equal the number of dimensions. The test uses a 2-dimensional array with an index array of size 3.
